# Literal Storyboard

> AI storytelling board game where each choice shapes allies, enemies and the story across a fantasy map.

## Endpoints
- Homepage: https://story.nevatal.id/
- API: https://story.nevatal.id/
- API Catalog: https://story.nevatal.id/.well-known/api-catalog
- Agent Card: https://story.nevatal.id/.well-known/agent-card.json
- AI Catalog: https://story.nevatal.id/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- Authentication Guide: https://story.nevatal.id/auth.md
